<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> The RBI has maintained the repo rate unchanged while projecting a 6.9% real GDP growth for the current fiscal year, though economists warn that rising inflation and global rate trends may necessitate future tightening.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NSE IPO Subscription:</strong> The National Stock Exchange’s ₹22,562 crore IPO closed with a 5.71x subscription, driven largely by Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) and led by significant bidding from LIC.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQNllSN1liZnVLZmh4X3lEZ1IxcmVpUUtCUTNWSEpCb0dwOFFWTUduT1A3ckNIYUgtNVg0Qmx6MjhyQU9Zd2VOQ0p0S3Y5bEYtTFFPWG9peE1ZejJDTG9kdnI3Wl9jVlhPT0lSRUNYODVjdmpQUDN5bHRxWnd0TFVsRE9ldnloWWp3ZmNzcFVHbWI4YUdWYlJ1RXFuT0g3T1E2NEVLMmtaTDZmV3Jj?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I37</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Dynamics:</strong> Domestic indices experienced volatility as FIIs continued selling while DIIs provided support, with broader market sentiment influenced by cooling crude oil prices and mixed sectoral performance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
